title: Surreal Melting Portrait
description: A young boy's face with closed eyes emerges from a cracked golden and turquoise tiled floor. His head is engulfed by a large, dripping purple organic form with bubbles and gold accents, from which a glowing yellow four-petaled flower grows upward. The background is a cosmic space scene with swirling green and purple nebulae, stars, and a distant planet.
